**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs, both from the shape change.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `options.retries` gone, renamed `retryCount` | Read both, throw a clear `TypeError` |
| [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag now `undefined`, threw | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 warnings are real but not fatal. Deprecated APIs like `crypto.createCipher` and `Buffer()`. Plus one circular import, `src/core/graph.js` and `src/state/tracker.js`.

Next: clean up those deprecations if you want a quiet log.
